paper.title: Observation of quantum entanglement with top quarks at the ATLAS detector

result.summary: 该论文报告了在大型强子对撞机（LHC）上利用 ATLAS 探测器，在质心能量 13 TeV、积分亮度 140 fb⁻¹ 的质子-质子对撞数据中，于顶夸克-反顶夸克对产生阈值附近观测到自旋纠缠 [abstract]。研究通过测量由母顶夸克静止系中带电轻子间夹角推断的单一观测量 D 来探测纠缠 [abstract]。在 340 < m_{t\bar{t}} < 380 GeV 区间测得 D = −0.537 ± 0.002 (stat.) ± 0.019 (syst.)，与无纠缠假设偏离超过五个标准差 [abstract]。这是首次在夸克对中观测到纠缠，也是迄今最高能量的纠缠观测 [abstract]。该观测展示了利用高能对撞机检验量子力学基础理解以及研究量子信息的潜力 [S1.p1][S1.SS4.p5]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在探索在最高可及能量尺度上的量子纠缠，此前纠缠在从微观到宏观的广泛系统中已被观测，但在最高能量尺度上仍基本未被探索 [abstract]。顶夸克因其极大质量导致寿命远短于强子化和自旋退相干的时间尺度，其自旋信息能传递给衰变产物，从而被提出作为研究量子纠缠和量子信息的新实验室 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。该观测还旨在展示利用 LHC 等高能对撞机作为检验量子力学基础理解工具的潜力 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: However, entanglement remains largely unexplored at the highest accessible energy scales.
Recently, the heaviest fundamental particle known to exist, the top quark, was proposed as a new laboratory to study quantum entanglement and quantum information.

its immense mass gives it a lifetime ( ${\sim}10^{-25}$ s) notably shorter than the timescale needed for a quark’s quantum numbers to be shrouded by hadronization ( ${\sim}10^{-24}$ s) and spin decorrelation ( ${\sim}10^{-21}$ s) effects.
this observation demonstrates the potential of using high-energy colliders, such as the LHC, as tools for testing our fundamental understanding of quantum mechanics.

method.text: 论文利用顶夸克-反顶夸克对的自旋关联来探测量子纠缠，通过测量由母顶夸克和反顶夸克静止系中带电轻子间夹角推断的单一观测量 D 来检测自旋纠缠 [abstract][S1.p2]。纠缠判据基于关联矩阵 C 的迹，tr[C]+1<0 是纠缠的充分条件，可理解为对 Cauchy–Schwarz 不等式的违反 [S1.p8]。测量在顶夸克对产生阈值附近的窄区间内进行，因为该区域约 80% 的产生截面来自最大纠缠的自旋单态 [abstract][S1.p8]。结果在由稳定粒子定义的基准相空间内报告，以最小化蒙特卡洛事件产生器和部分子簇射模型在模拟顶夸克对产生时的局限所导致的不确定性 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: Spin entanglement is detected from the measurement of a single observable D D , inferred from the angle between the charged leptons in their parent top- and antitop-quark rest frames.
the spin correlation between the top quark and antitop quark is used to probe the effects of quantum entanglement
the trace (the sum of all of the diagonal elements) of the correlation matrix $\mathbf{C}$ ... is a good entanglement witness.
with $\textrm{tr}[\mathbf{C}]+1<0$ as a sufficient condition for entanglement.
approximately 80% of the production cross-section of $t\bar{t}$ pairs arises from a spin-singlet state, which is maximally entangled.
It is reported in a fiducial phase space defined with stable particles to minimize the uncertainties that stem from limitations of the Monte Carlo event generators and the parton shower model

experiments.text: 测量使用 ATLAS 探测器在质心能量 13 TeV、积分亮度 140 fb⁻¹ 下记录的质子-质子对撞数据 [abstract]。分析使用蒙特卡洛事件模拟来建模 t\bar{t} 信号和背景过程，t\bar{t} 产生用 Powheg Box v2 hvq 生成器在 NLO 精度下模拟，并接口到 Pythia 8.230 或 Herwig 7.2.1 来模拟部分子簇射和强子化 [S1.SS1.p4]。事件被分为三个分析区域，信号区被构造为尽可能接近产生阈值，因为这是预期顶夸克纠缠最大化的区域 [S1.SS2.p3]。顶夸克从双轻子衰变产物中重建，主要使用 Ellipse 方法解析计算中微子动量，该方法在 85% 的事件中给出至少一个实数解 [Ax1.SS5.p3]。

evidence.quote: using a proton–proton collision dataset with a center-of-mass energy of s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV and an integrated luminosity of 140 fb -1 recorded with the ATLAS experiment.

The production of $t\bar{t}$ events was modeled using the Powheg Box v2 heavy-quark (hvq) generator at next-to-leading order (NLO) precision in QCD and the events were interfaced to either Pythia 8.230 or Herwig 7.2.1

The signal region is constructed to be dominated by events that are as close to the production threshold as the resolution of the reconstruction method will allow, as this is the region where the entanglement of the top quarks is expected to be maximized.
The main method used in this work is the Ellipse method, which is a geometric approach to analytically calculate the neutrino momenta. This method yields at least one real solution in 85% of events.

findings.text: 在 340 < m_{t\bar{t}} < 380 GeV 区间，纠缠标记测量值为 D = −0.537 ± 0.002 (stat.) ± 0.019 (syst.) [abstract]。观测结果与无纠缠情景偏离超过五个标准差，构成首次在夸克对中观测到纠缠，也是迄今最高能量的纠缠观测 [abstract]。在信号区，观测和预期显著性相对于纠缠极限均远超五个标准差，且独立于用于将纠缠极限修正到测量基准相空间的蒙特卡洛模型 [S1.SS4.p4]。该结果确立了纠缠 t\bar{t} 态的形成 [S1.SS4.p4]。

evidence.quote: The entanglement marker is measured to be D = − 0.537 ± 0.002 ​ (stat.) ± 0.019 ​ (syst.) D=-0.537\pm0.002\penalty\ \text{(stat.)}\pm0.019\penalty\ \text{(syst.)} for 340 < m t ​ t ¯ < 380 340<m_{t\bar{t}}<380 GeV .

The observed result is more than five standard deviations from a scenario without entanglement and constitutes the first observation of entanglement in a pair of quarks and the highest-energy observation of entanglement so far.
the observed and expected significances with respect to the entanglement limit are well beyond five standard deviations, independently of the MC model used to correct the entanglement limit
The observed result in the region with $340<m_{t\bar{t}}<380$ GeV establishes the formation of entangled $t\bar{t}$ states.

limitations.text: 论文指出，由于无法控制初始态的内部自由度，展示 t\bar{t} 对中的自旋纠缠具有挑战性，目前只能在像本文这样的受限相空间内通过专门分析来探测纠缠 [S1.p10]。此外，蒙特卡洛事件产生器中将矩阵元与部分子簇射算法结合的程序，在未来更高精度的 LHC 量子信息研究中需要特别关注 [Ax1.SS10.p7]。

evidence.quote: a demonstration of spin entanglement in $t\bar{t}$ pairs is challenging due to the inability to control the internal degrees of freedom in the initial state.
Currently, entanglement can only be detected with the help of a dedicated analysis in a restricted phase space like the one presented here.
The procedure used in MC event generators to combine the matrix element with a parton-shower algorithm requires special attention in future higher-precision quantum information studies at the LHC.
